source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. The paper prints "Final Term Examination 2017-2018"; examYear 2018 is the later year of that session. It is a single Science paper (Full Marks : 80, Time : 2hrs.+15mins.) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology items mixed within Section - A and Section - B (no subject sections); this pack holds the items judged to be Biology (26 items, 49 of the 80 marks), so maxMarks is left null. Question numbers restart in Section - B and are prefixed "B" here. Section - A Q2 prints [5x1=5] but only three items appear. The flower figure for Section - B Q4 is missing from the file. The icseboard.org watermark is ignored. Classification topics (kingdom, species, mammals, scientific names, cold-blooded animals, plant types, roots) have no matching chapter and are chapter null. Section - A Q6 (match the following) mixes subjects and is kept whole here.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
